contract: Daily prioritizes the selected date, task title, and up to two lines of notes on a translucent dark surface. Recurring event editors distinguish the series note from the selected occurrence. Monthly retains centered week bands and date navigation at the widget minimum size.

accessibility.evidence: Edge with reduced motion enabled showed a keyboard focus outline on the card after Tab and Shift+Tab. Enter opened the labeled editor. The save and scope controls were exercised by accessible name; textarea is inside its visible label.

responsive.evidence: Inspected screenshots of the default Daily board and minimum-size editor and Monthly view. A long Korean note fit the editor horizontally. The dialog and month can scroll vertically at minimum height.

loading.evidence: Manual sync disabled the button and displayed its in-progress label while the test bridge delayed its reply, then restored it.

empty.evidence: An empty test calendar rendered zero cards and kept the Todo add action available.

error.evidence: Rejected save displayed the editor error and retained the multiline draft. Retrying succeeded.

partial.evidence: A locally saved occurrence note rendered on its card while the footer indicated pending transmission.

success.evidence: Reopened the occurrence, read its saved note, cleared it, and observed the intact series note in the card preview.

permission.evidence: With the repository disconnected in the fixture, attempting to add a task produced the connection-required status. No live account or credentials were used.

renderedEvidence.observation: Sample tasks and multiline previews in three aligned columns, with date navigation and last sync time.
Scrollable occurrence editor with a separate read-only series note and focused multiline field.
Seven date columns fit horizontally with colored multi-day bands and one centered name per week.
